SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is early marriage harmful? (1 mark)
   A. It makes children rich
   B. It stops education and harms health
   C. It helps children learn
   D. It is fun

2. Which is an effect of child abuse? (1 mark)
   A. Fear and lost education
   B. More friends
   C. Better health
   D. Higher marks

3. What is child abuse? (1 mark)
   A. Treating a child in a way that harms the child
   B. Playing with a child
   C. Teaching a child
   D. Feeding a child

4. Which of these is a trusted adult? (1 mark)
   A. A stranger you met online
   B. A person who gives you sweets in secret
   C. A person who threatens you
   D. A parent or teacher

5. What is a responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. A duty you should do
   B. A secret
   C. A toy
   D. A gift

6. What is female genital mutilation? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of food
   B. Cutting a girl's private parts, which is harmful and illegal
   C. A kind of school
   D. A kind of sport

7. What is a ballot paper? (1 mark)
   A. A paper on which a voter marks a choice
   B. A ticket for a bus
   C. A menu
   D. A kind of book

8. What does democracy mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rule by one person
   B. No rules
   C. Rule by the people
   D. Rule by force

9. What is a mock election? (1 mark)
   A. A school holiday
   B. A game with no rules
   C. A practice election
   D. A real national election

10. Which of these is a way of participating in the Children's Government? (1 mark)
   A. Voting for leaders
   B. Breaking rules
   C. Ignoring elections
   D. Laughing at leaders

11. How are members of the Children's Government chosen? (1 mark)
   A. By luck at a market
   B. By buying votes
   C. By election
   D. By force

12. Who usually guides a Children's Government? (1 mark)
   A. A stranger
   B. A police officer
   C. A teacher patron
   D. A driver

13. Which minister would organise a football match between classes? (1 mark)
   A. Health
   B. Library
   C. Sports and games
   D. Environment

14. Why is it important for leaders to have good qualities? (1 mark)
   A. Resources are wasted
   B. People trust them and live in peace
   C. People fear them
   D. People quarrel

15. What happens when leaders are dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. The community grows faster
   B. Trust is lost and resources are wasted
   C. People are happier
   D. Nothing changes

16. What do village elders do? (1 mark)
   A. Fly aeroplanes
   B. Welcome visitors and help settle small quarrels
   C. Teach maths only
   D. Make cars

17. Who leads a clan? (1 mark)
   A. A footballer
   B. A bus driver
   C. Clan elders
   D. A cook

18. Who is closest to the people among county administrators? (1 mark)
   A. The speaker
   B. The governor
   C. The president
   D. The village administrator

19. Who elects the governor? (1 mark)
   A. The teachers
   B. Registered voters in the county
   C. The chief
   D. The president alone

20. How many MCAs does each ward elect? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Fifty
   C. None
   D. One

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Design a poster: write a slogan and list three qualities of a good leader you would show on it. (5 marks)

22. In a class election, Maria got 14 votes, Juma got 9 votes and 2 papers were spoilt. How many pupils voted? Who won? Show working. (3 marks)

23. Name three kinds of community leaders. (3 marks)

24. Give four duties of a religious leader. (4 marks)

25. Explain the meaning of democracy. (2 marks)

26. Name three child rights. (3 marks)

27. Where can a child go for help if they are being harmed? (2 marks)

28. Who is a clan elder? (2 marks)

29. Explain three effects of child abuse on a child. (3 marks)

30. State three benefits of democracy in school. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It stops education and harms health
   Early marriage harms girls and boys.

2. A — Fear and lost education
   Abuse harms the child's life.

3. A — Treating a child in a way that harms the child
   Abuse harms a child's body, feelings or future.

4. D — A parent or teacher
   Trusted adults protect children.

5. A — A duty you should do
   Rights come with responsibilities.

6. B — Cutting a girl's private parts, which is harmful and illegal
   FGM harms girls and is against the law.

7. A — A paper on which a voter marks a choice
   Voters mark ballot papers.

8. C — Rule by the people
   Democracy means the people have a say.

9. C — A practice election
   A mock election teaches how voting works.

10. A — Voting for leaders
   Voting is part of participating.

11. C — By election
   Pupils vote for their leaders.

12. C — A teacher patron
   A teacher adviser guides the pupils.

13. C — Sports and games
   Sports leaders organise games.

14. B — People trust them and live in peace
   Good leaders build trust and peace.

15. B — Trust is lost and resources are wasted
   Dishonesty harms the community.

16. B — Welcome visitors and help settle small quarrels
   Village elders help the village.

17. C — Clan elders
   Clan elders lead the clan.

18. D — The village administrator
   Village administrators work closest to families.

19. B — Registered voters in the county
   Voters in the county elect the governor.

20. D — One
   Each ward elects one MCA.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: A slogan such as A Good Leader Serves, and qualities such as honest, fair and kind, with a picture.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a slogan, 3 marks for three qualities, 1 mark for a picture.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: 25 pupils voted. Maria won.
   Working / marking points: 14 + 9 + 2 = 25. 14 is more than 9, so Maria won. 1 mark for the total, 1 mark for the winner, 1 mark for showing working.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Religious leaders, clan elders and village elders. Accept chiefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each kind.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Lead prayers, teach values, counsel people and visit the sick. Accept conducting weddings or funerals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each duty.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Democracy is rule by the people, where everyone has a say in choosing leaders and making decisions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rule by the people, 1 mark for having a say.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: The right to education, to health care and to protection. Accept food, a name or play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each right.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: To a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, or to the child helpline 116.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct source of help.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: A clan elder is an older respected member of a clan who leads it and keeps its customs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for respected older member, 1 mark for leading or keeping customs.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pain and illness, fear and sadness, and missing school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each effect.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everyone has a voice, decisions are fair, and pupils obey rules they helped to make.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.
